dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-dorsal region displays three prominent 'O'-shaped structures with sharp, dark perimeters transitioning abruptly to light-colored centers. One 'C'-shaped structure is visible towards the posterior, characterized by a discontinuous perimeter and a moderate gradient from the dark border to the interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of small, asymmetrical dark blobs concentrated in the mid-anterior dorsal area. These blobs show uniform low-intensity pixel cores and lack internal gradients, appearing as solid clusters against the lighter substrate.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest 'O' structures in the central dorsal zone form a scalene triangle. A secondary geometric relationship is formed by a group of four distinct dark blobs in the mid-lateral region, which align into an irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: The snout region features high-contrast vibrissae, appearing as distinct linear high-intensity pixel arrangements against the darker anterior background.
